story.logline: A traveler escapes the airport crowd and reaches a waiting car.
story.story_promise: A tense arrival resolves into a clean getaway.
story.objective: Move the traveler from terminal exit to vehicle departure without losing screen direction.
story.initial_condition: The traveler exits the terminal into rain and crowd pressure.
story.final_outcome: The car pulls away into traffic after the traveler is safely inside.

world_bible.location: airport curbside pickup lane in light rain
world_bible.vehicle_identity: black sedan with rear passenger door
world_bible.persistent_environment: glass terminal doors, wet curb, taxi lights
world_bible.character_specific_object: creased paper airline tag looped around the suitcase handle

scenes.narrative_function: Complete the arrival handoff from terminal exit to vehicle departure.
scenes.audio_plan: Clips carry curb ambience and sync SFX; score is unified in post.

beats.description: Traveler exits the terminal into curbside rain.
Traveler reaches the open rear door.
Traveler gets into the car and closes the door.
Vehicle leaves the crowd and disappears into traffic.

clips.narrative_job: Exit terminal and approach the open rear car door.
clips.felt_intent: The viewer notices that her pace never changes even when the waiting car comes within reach.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Advance arrival to the threshold of shelter without pretending the traveler reached it.
authoring_state.turn: Public endurance at the terminal becomes shelter within two steps while exposure continues.
authoring_state.pov: The traveler; the waiting car holds her gaze but remains visibly unreached at the accepted endpoint.
authoring_state.power_shift: Rain and curb traffic still control her exposed movement; the car has not yet become her boundary.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Reach the waiting car without letting the curbside crowd see how exhausted she is.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: The exposed curb, rain, and rolling suitcase invite a hurried release; she keeps one measured tempo and fixes her eyes on the open door.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: The car promises relief, but the accepted take leaves her still performing public endurance.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: At a curb seam, her thumb hooks beneath the creased airline tag, then releases it without looking down.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: A creased paper airline tag looped around the suitcase handle catches under her thumb at a curb seam.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No relieved smile, sagging shoulders, or backward glance; replace them with the thumb catching and releasing the tag while her pace stays even.
authoring_state.value_before: arrival is public endurance with shelter still distant
authoring_state.value_after: shelter is within two steps while public endurance continues
prompt_carriers: She sees the open rear door but keeps the same measured walking tempo.
At a curb seam, her thumb hooks beneath the creased airline tag, then releases it without looking down.
She remains two steps from the open rear door, mid-stride, with her face and shoulders held level.

clips.narrative_job: Complete the last two steps, reach the open rear door, enter the car, and close the door.
clips.felt_intent: The viewer hears public exposure end when the door thump cuts the curb noise.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Convert shelter from a visible promise into a boundary she closes herself.
authoring_state.turn: Public endurance continues two steps from the car, then curb noise and exposure are cut off by the shut door.
authoring_state.pov: The traveler; the camera stays at her wet shoulder until the closed door removes the curb from her sensory field.
authoring_state.power_shift: The curb controls her exposure at the start; she controls the boundary when her hand pulls the door shut.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Get behind closed glass without giving the curbside crowd a readable release.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: Two exposed steps and rain on her face invite a visible reaction; she redirects the wiping impulse into folding the tag under the suitcase handle before entering.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: She accepts shelter through an exact practical gesture while her face continues to deny that she needed it.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: Her fingers start toward the rain on her cheek, then redirect to fold the creased tag beneath the suitcase handle.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: A creased paper airline tag looped around the suitcase handle is folded beneath the handle only after the car can shield the action.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No shoulder drop, backward glance, or relieved smile; replace them with the redirected hand, inward-facing tag, and the door thump cutting curb noise.
authoring_state.value_before: shelter is within two steps while public endurance continues
authoring_state.value_after: the closed door severs public exposure without a performed release
prompt_carriers: Her fingers start toward the rain on her cheek, then redirect to fold the creased airline tag beneath the suitcase handle.
She keeps the suitcase upright until the rear door shuts, then turns it so the folded tag faces the seatback.
The door thump cuts the curb noise while her face and shoulders remain level.

clips.felt_intent: The viewer watches terminal light leave the creased tag and not return.

authoring_state.dramatic_function: Pay off the arrival by letting the terminal lose visual possession of the traveler.
authoring_state.turn: The closed car is a temporary boundary, then the terminal disappears and departure becomes the settled direction.
authoring_state.pov: The traveler through the suitcase at her knees; the terminal is registered as moving light rather than a reaction close-up.
authoring_state.power_shift: The terminal still occupies the rear glass at the start; the moving car removes it from the frame by the end.
authoring_state.hidden_want_objective: Let the terminal disappear without turning departure into a public declaration.
authoring_state.obstacle_tactic: Terminal light keeps crossing the rear window; she presses the lifted corner of the creased tag flat and slides the suitcase deeper into the footwell.
authoring_state.subtext_contradiction: She completes departure by tending to an ordinary travel object rather than acknowledging the building behind her.
authoring_state.visible_suppressed_behavior: Her forefinger lifts one corner of the tag as terminal light reaches it, then presses the same crease flat.
authoring_state.non_transferable_detail: A creased paper airline tag looped around the suitcase handle catches one final stripe of terminal light.
authoring_state.stock_solution_refused: No wistful rear-window look, head turn, or face close-up; replace them with terminal light crossing the tag and leaving it dark.
authoring_state.value_before: the closed door severs public exposure without a performed release
authoring_state.value_after: departure is settled when the terminal no longer reaches her frame
prompt_carriers: A stripe of terminal light crosses the creased airline tag at her knees.
Her forefinger lifts one corner of the tag, then presses the same crease flat as she slides the suitcase deeper into the footwell.
End when the terminal light leaves the tag and does not return.
